invariants.rationale: tileSet is dereferenced by putTile, so it must be non-null.
textureRegion is required to construct StaticTiledMapTile, so it must be non-null.
tileId is used as a key in tileSet; negative ids are typically invalid.
TiledMapTileSet count should be non-negative before any addition.
The intention may be to add a new tile; the id should not already be present.
